purpose: High-density reverse-coverage diagnostic for the E3 DR and YY GPU implementations

gpu.required_gate: existing E3 CPU/GPU equivalence gate must PASS

execution: evaluate only the 768 new query points and merge them with the immutable 256-query formal packets

metric.E_reverse: max over 65536 deterministic reference points of distance to nearest successful fitted query point
metric.E_reverse_mean: mean over the same reference grid
metric.delta_query: same reverse distance with exact query points replacing fitted points
